$comment: Higgsfield generations commissioned for this site. Run 'npm run assets:fetch' to download them into this folder, then 'npm run assets:optimise' to transcode them into public/media. These are brand/atmosphere visuals — NOT photographs of completed Kabura customer projects. See assets-src/README.md.

assets.usedFor: Homepage hero still + poster, /bathrooms hero, bathroom service panel
assets.prompt: Wide architectural interior photograph of an ultra-modern luxury bathroom in a high-end Australian home, floor-to-ceiling large-format warm greige stone porcelain, frameless glass walk-in shower, floating vanity, brushed bronze tapware, soft morning daylight. No people, no text, no logos.

Dramatic dark luxury bathroom, honed charcoal basalt-look large-format tiles, backlit book-matched stone feature wall, sculptural freestanding bath, brushed bronze tapware, deep shadow. No people, no text, no logos.
